answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 14 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in mesa, checked in plume, and quill shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2551 identities would post 4424 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
